body:
**Blocked by:** #1065, #1066, #1067
**Model tier:** low

## Context

Model tier rationale: This updates one existing catalog assertion using its existing SQL result; it introduces no schema or isolation policy.

The listed blockers also edit tenancyCatalog.test.ts. Apply this follow-up after their legacy-key, composite-FK and strictness changes so the final catalog suite has one owner at a time; none is claimed to fix this skipped assertion.

- PR #1109, finding `cb42d93e3f`, `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/tenancyCatalog.test.ts:414`: The catalog query collects tenant foreign keys for partitions, but the assertion skips every items_p_ row.

## Task

Apply the existing `fk_targets` equality assertion to every row returned by the tenant-column catalog test, including all `items_p_` partitions. Preserve the existing requirement that the single-column `tenant_id` foreign key targets `tenants(id)` and the existing partition-presence, type, nullability and default checks. Make only this assertion repair in the final catalog suite left by the blockers.

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/tenancyCatalog.test.ts (the tenant_id column/FK catalog test only)

## Scope

### In scope

The skipped partition FK assertion and its existing integration coverage.

### Out of scope

Schema changes, composite-FK design, strict-mode behavior and the blockers' other catalog rules.

## Acceptance criteria

- For finding `cb42d93e3f`, the integration catalog test checks `fk_targets` equals `["tenants"]` for every returned item partition as well as every tenant parent table; no `items_p_` name-based exclusion remains, and the populated catalog test passes.
